summary.text: You can withdraw CPFIS investments if you have set aside the Full Retirement Sum in your Retirement Account.

details.heading: If you have the FRS
details.body: Apply through the Investment dashboard. Your agent bank and product providers will convert the investments to cash investments in your personal accounts. Your Investment Account will then be closed, and any balance will be paid to you in cash.

details.heading: If you do not have the FRS
details.body: You cannot withdraw your CPFIS investments. You can still sell the investments. The sale proceeds will be returned to your CPF Ordinary Account, or to your Retirement Account up to the FRS if you used your Special Account.

quotes.text: If you have set aside the Full Retirement Sum (FRS) in your Retirement Account, you can apply to withdraw your CPFIS by closing your CPF Investment Account with your agent bank and ceasing your participation under the CPFIS.
To apply, please submit your application through the Investment dashboard.
If you have not set aside the FRS in your Retirement Account, you would not be able to withdraw your CPFIS investments.
